items.definition:
extremely large or great
The project required an immense amount of effort.

tending to choose carefully
She is very selective about her friends.

using cruel or violent language or treatment
He was accused of abusive behavior.

hopeful and confident about the future
She's always optimistic about her chances of success.

constituting a problem or difficulty
The new policy proved to be highly problematic.

relating to the publicizing of a product, organization, or venture
They launched a new promotional campaign.

done or acting according to a fixed plan or system; methodical
They conducted a systematic review of the evidence.

having started and in progress
Preparations for the event are already underway.

likely to change or give way; not stable
The political situation in the country is very unstable.

of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning
She gave a vague answer to the question.

old and valuable
She collects antique furniture.

relating to behavior
She studies behavioral patterns in animals.

relating to fiction
The characters in the novel are entirely fictional.

deadly
The snake's venom was lethal.

subject to death; causing death
All humans are mortal.

not making or conducted primarily to make a profit
She works for a nonprofit organization.

serving as a symbol
The dove is symbolic of peace.

wished for as being an attractive, useful, or necessary quality
A good work-life balance is highly desirable.

expressing approval; advantageous or suitable
The weather forecast is favorable for our picnic.

relating to geography
The geographical features of the region are diverse.

relating to government
Governmental policies can have a big impact on the economy.

very long
The meeting was a lengthy discussion.

following one another or following others
They won the championship for three successive years.

done or occurring at a favorable or appropriate time
The timely arrival of the ambulance saved his life.

complete; absolute
The meeting was an utter disaster.

creating a distinctive mood
The old house had a very atmospheric feel.

having the characteristics of a hero or heroine; very brave
The firefighters made a heroic effort to save the building.

relating to the Nobel Prizes
She won a Nobel Prize for her research.

existing as a natural part
There are inherent risks in any investment.

famous for something bad
The area is notorious for its high crime rate.

relating to an organization
Good organizational skills are essential for this job.

simple and easy to understand
The instructions were very straightforward.

deliberately cruel or violent
The dog gave a vicious bark.

intentional; done on purpose
His actions were deliberate, not accidental.

relating to geology or the study of the Earth's physical structure
The area has interesting geological formations.

not enough or not good enough
The resources provided were inadequate for the task.

without thinking or caring about the consequences
His reckless driving caused the accident.

consisting of or resembling wood
The plant has a woody stem.

having no value or use
The old car was worthless.

deserving honor and respect; bringing honor
He made an honorable decision to resign.

likely to spread infection; (of a quality or feeling) likely to spread to others
His enthusiasm was infectious, and soon everyone was excited.

lower in rank, status, or quality
This product is of inferior quality compared to the other one.

having special rights, advantages, or immunities
She felt privileged to be part of the exclusive club.

continuing for a long time or longer than usual
The patient required prolonged medical attention.

unwilling and hesitant
He was reluctant to admit his mistake.

feeling, showing, or expressing sympathy
She was very sympathetic to my problems.

settling an issue conclusively; having the power to make decisions quickly
Her decisive action saved the company from ruin.

very dirty
The kitchen was absolutely filthy after the party.

happening in a way that is contrary to what is expected, and typically amusing as a result
It's ironic that he's a teacher but hates reading.

relating to an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development of something
They lived in a primitive hut with no electricity.

relating to or denoting faculties or phenomena that are apparently inexplicable by natural laws, especially involving telepathy or clairvoyance
She claimed to have psychic abilities.

not connected
His comments were completely unrelated to the topic.

empty
The house has been vacant for months.

connected by wires; tense
The whole building is wired for internet access.

fated; predetermined
She felt she was destined for greatness.

not consistent; contradictory
His statements were inconsistent with the evidence.

having or expressing devotion to and vigorous support for one's country
He felt a strong patriotic duty to serve his country.

based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions
Beauty is often considered a subjective concept.

inhabiting a land from the earliest times
The aboriginal peoples of Australia have a rich culture.

relating to the body
He suffered severe bodily harm.

produced by two or more parties working together
It was a collaborative effort by the whole team.

serving a useful purpose; tending to build up
We need to provide constructive feedback.

relating to the universe or cosmos
The telescope revealed a cosmic dust cloud.

relating to the process of developing
The child is going through a developmental stage.
